info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Direction Continuity Planning API
info.description: The Business Direction Continuity Planning API enables organizations to effectively manage and remove continuity plans aligned with their business strategy. This API allows users to delete specific continuity planning entries, helping maintain an up-to-date and relevant set of strategies. It is particularly useful for financial institutions and risk management teams as they adjust their operational plans. By streamlining this process, businesses can ensure that their continuity strategies reflect current goals and mitigate potential disruptions.

delete.summary: Remove a specific continuity planning resource.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specified continuity planning resource identified by its unique ID. Ensure that you want to permanently remove this resource as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific continuity planning resource identified by RES-100045. It should contain the necessary parameters for the deletion operation.
